verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents its own REST API (trigger deployments, export analytics), so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing on API versioning or a deprecation policy for that API. The 'version search filters' mention refers to filtering versioned documentation content, an adjacent docs-site feature rather than a versioned API with a deprecation policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
